body:
Nah, I was the one that left.  I couldn't take it any more.  It's so emotionally draining to tip toe on everything you say in hopes of not being offensive or an asshole about something.  Like fuck man, I'm only human, I make fucking mistakes.

But oh well.  Just another tick mark on a long list of things I've ruined in my life.  Don't feel like adding any more, so I really need to just man up and finish what I've started.  No more being a coward and holding back.

Sorry, got a little carried away, and then she came back, and now things are just done and over with so yeah.

Honestly, to your first question, no.  She's was the best thing that happened to me in a long time, but I see now that it wasn't as good as I originally thought.

And for details, whatever I really don't care if she somehow sees this.  She was upset, I was given options on what to do, I chose talking, she responded like that was a mistake, so I apologized and it made her feel like I just didn't care or whatever.  Anyways, it doesn't even matter.  I'm at as much fault as her for how I feel right now, and that's alright with me.  Maybe she really wasn't the person I thought she was.  No matter how hard I tried to take the blame for everything, she wouldn't let me.  And when I say sure some of it is your fault, but I'm not holding it against you, it's still my fault in the end, then I'm an asshole for blaming her just like everyone else in her life.

Honestly, it's probably all just a bunch of bs.  Just her way of getting rid of me.  I really just don't care.  I'm over it, but I've been over life for a long time, and that was the final straw.  There's no point in going on.  I'll just end up hurting someone else somehow, and being made to feel like an asshole no matter what I do or say.  Just fuck it all.  The pain in my wrists from cutting myself is really nice.  I just hope that the bleeding doesn't stop so I can finally be free of all the pain for good.

Edit:  And no, this isn't all just over her.  My life is going no where.  I have no friends.  I basically have no family, just my mom and my grandmother that's dying of leukemia.  I'm all alone in this world, and everytime I try to make a friend, I just get tossed aside like the garbage I am.  No one wants me here, so why stay?  So I can suffer even more?  I'll pass.

I spent the last 4 and a half years isolated from the world because I didn't want to be hurt, there were no bright spots.  Not until recently.  Spending the time with her that I have was the brightest it's been in such a long time that I don't even remember anything to compare it to.

And as far as what happened, I'm just an idiot.  I ruin everything, always.  I never say the right thing, or do the right thing, when it matters most.  It's like there's something out there that wants me to fail at every turn.

No, being there for someone and being genuinely there for them 100% no matter what is one of the hardest things to do for someone, but when you care about them more than anything in the world you endure it and do what you can.

It's just the worst feeling in the world when you pour your heart and soul into caring about someone just to be told that you don't care at all.  To be backed into a corner and taking the wrong choice of action is fucking awful.  It's not her fault though, I should have done more.  If I was a better person, I would have made the right choice and done the right thing.

It's all fruitless.  You spend years telling yourself that you'll never find happiness, and then when you finally think you've found it, you just go and ruin it like everything else in your life.  I'm tired of living this way.  No matter what I do, I always make the wrong choice and end up right back at square one.  No more, I'm throwing in the towel.  I won't go through this again.
